description: From Elmwood Park in downtown Roanoke: over the Walnut Avenue bridge and up Mill Mountain, along the Mill Mountain Parkway to the Blue Ridge Parkway, up and back down Roanoke Mountain, back to Mill Mountain and up to the Mill Mountain Star, down Prospect Road's Old Road to the Roanoke River Greenway, then Peakwood and West Ridge, over the Jefferson Street bridge, and through Old Southwest and Highland Park to the finish. Unofficial.

source.notes: The 2025–2026 course (the Wasena Bridge reroute), USATF certified VA24031RT. Route traced over OpenStreetMap roads, greenways and paths, including the Roanoke Mountain Loop Road, closed to traffic but run up and back down on race day; distances are calibrated to mile points on the certificate, several with GPS. Elevations from USGS 3DEP 1 m lidar; bridges are interpolated. The official "7,430 ft" is gain plus loss. Downhills are flat on a treadmill without decline. Unofficial.
